title: Stage 3 Etsy listing (model output; validated again locally)

title.description: Etsy title, search intent first: primary search phrase, product type / subject, key differentiator, secondary search intent. Never the internal product name (it can appear in the description). Not all capitals, no emoji, no keyword lists.

description.description: Warm Etsy description in plain text, in this order: emotional hook (never file types first), product experience, designs, what you receive (bullets), how it works, emotional use case with a soft closing line, digital product disclosure last. Short paragraphs, emoji per the strategy, no markdown symbols, no em dashes beyond two. Must say it is a digital download and no physical item is shipped.

tag_candidates.description: A pool of 18-20 concise Etsy search phrases, best first, mixing product, occasion, style, recipient/use and format. Code, not you, picks the final 13 Etsy tags: it discards any candidate over 20 characters, with other characters, duplicated (ignoring case), or beyond 6 that use only title words. So prefer phrases of 20 characters or fewer, make them genuinely different, and give enough that some can be discarded. No keyword stuffing.

items.description: One search phrase. Aim for 20 characters or fewer (Etsy counts every character, spaces included). Letters, numbers, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens only.
One material, 45 characters or fewer; letters, numbers, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens only (code drops entries that are not).

materials.description: What the customer receives, e.g. "Digital PDF", "PNG artwork files". Keep each entry short and plain.

suggested_price_gbp.description: Advisory GBP price as a plain JSON number of pounds, with at most 2 decimals (e.g. 4.99, 6.5 or 12). Never a string: no £ sign, no range, no words. The owner decides the real price.

category_suggestion.description: Suggested Etsy category path, e.g. "Paper & Party Supplies > Paper > Greeting Cards".

customer_summary.description: Two or three customer-facing sentences: what it is, why it is appealing, the main differentiator, how it is delivered. Not a compressed file list.

digital_download_disclaimer.description: States clearly that this is a digital download and that no physical item is shipped.

listing_claims.description: The key customer-facing factual claims the listing makes, each mapped to one allowed claim key. Target 6-10 strong claims; never more than 12. Prefer fewer strong claims over restating every production fact; no separate claims for trivial implementation details. Do not add claims just to fill capacity.

key.description: One of the allowed listing_claims keys given in the user message. Keys may repeat across claims.

text.description: The short claim text exactly as used in the listing.
